contexts.text: Man is born again through truths of faith. HH 342. [Swedenborg footnote 1.]
He ought to be born again as an infant...
Regeneration is called rebirth, but spiritual.
The man who is being born again...
The rebirth of the Sensual subject to the intellectual part, Treated of. AC 5122.

In order to be delivered from Hell, man must be wholly born again by the Lord. It is this rebirth which is called regeneration. In order therefore that he may be born again he must first learn truths...
Regeneration is rebirth as to the spiritual man. Described.
Good is not acknowledged to be prior until the man has been reborn.
Thus he comes again into the womb, and is reborn.
The rebirth of this Sensuous. Described.
The influx through which is the rebirth. Signified, Explained.
The man who is being reborn. Described.
The states of the rebirth of this Sensuous. Signified.
The rebirth of the Sensuous subject to the intellectual part. Treated of.
In order that man may be reborn...
This was the first of the rebirth of the Natural.
As the Natural cannot be reborn as to intellectual things alone...
For the man who is in good is being reborn every moment... to eternity, not only as to the interiors, but also as to the exteriors, and this by stupendous processes...
The rebirth of both Naturals, interior and exterior. Treated of.
To be born = to be reborn.
The spiritual coming forth and rebirth of the Spiritual Church. Signified.
